rules.operands: Scalar operand origins join; evaluation follows source order and ignores comments.
rules.assignments: Evaluate scalar RHS leaves once, then write literal-shaped targets from left to right.
rules.selectors: Boolean and None literals select expression paths; unknown truth retains alternatives.
rules.comparisons: Evaluate ordered comparison operands; comparison truth remains unknown.
rules.statements: Join if/elif alternatives and loop fixed points; preserve break, continue and loop else.
rules.calls: Evaluate explicit arguments in source order, then bind positions and exact keyword names.
rules.defaults: Omitted immutable literal defaults carry no source origins; explicit arguments override them.
rules.returns: Substitute scalar helper summaries; return and explicit raise terminate their paths.
rules.recursion: Recursive scalar summaries grow to a fixed point; each call substitutes its own origins.
rules.imports: Resolve static local modules within one root; preserve defining-file identities and lookup evidence.
rules.rules: Sources, sinks, sanitizers and propagators are caller-supplied contracts.
rules.names: Local bindings and shadowing prevent guessed external calls or unbound value claims.
rules.locations: Witnesses retain source revisions, UTF-8 byte spans and one-based Unicode columns.
rules.boundaries: Unsupported syntax and exhausted budgets remain incomplete; implicit exceptions are outside the model.

limits: Finite scalar examples, not full Python correctness or path feasibility. Implicit exceptions, aliases and dynamic dispatch remain outside this model. Runtime observations cover only declared inputs. Retained output is not execution attestation. No live-agent, token-efficiency or repository-generalization claim.

expression_control.boundary: scalar truth and comparisons; no overloaded protocols or implicit exceptions.

function_summaries.claim: may-value derivations in the declared model; neither feasible paths nor runtime termination.
function_summaries.context: symbolic explicit parameters; bind each call independently and fill omitted literal defaults.

assignment_control.binding: match literal tuple/list shapes; write local names and chained targets left-to-right.

assignment_control.limits: 64 RHS shape nodes, 64 target names, 64 chained targets and nesting depth 16 per assignment.

call_binding.binding: positional slots followed by exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: no evaluated or mutable defaults, annotations, variadics, unpacking, keyword external-rule contracts or non-normalized identifier spellings.

call_binding.invalid: incomplete analysis for missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII-named positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only parameters; required or immutable literal defaults.
